items.name: ColumnReader
items.summary: Column reader for a Parquet type.

items.name: get_column_reader
items.signature: fn get_column_reader(col_descr: schema::types::ColumnDescPtr, col_page_reader: Box<dyn PageReader>) -> ColumnReader
items.summary: Gets a specific column reader corresponding to column descriptor `col_descr`. The column reader will read from pages in `col_page_reader`.

items.name: get_typed_column_reader
items.summary: Gets a typed column reader for the specific type `T`, by "up-casting" `col_reader` of non-generic type to a generic column reader type `ColumnReaderImpl`.

items.name: GenericColumnReader
items.summary: Reads data for a given column chunk, using the provided decoders:

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new(descr: ColumnDescPtr, page_reader: Box<dyn PageReader>) -> Self
methods.summary: Creates new column reader based on column descriptor and page reader.

methods.name: read_records
methods.signature: fn read_records(&mut self, max_records: usize, def_levels: Option<&mut D::Buffer>, rep_levels: Option<&mut R::Buffer>, values: &mut V::Buffer) -> Result<(usize, usize, usize)>
methods.summary: Read up to `max_records` whole records, returning the number of complete records, non-null values and levels decoded. All levels for a given record will be read, i.e. the next repetition level, if any, will be 0

methods.name: skip_records
methods.signature: fn skip_records(&mut self, num_records: usize) -> Result<usize>
methods.summary: Skips over `num_records` records, where records are delimited by repetition levels of 0
